name: OpenAI Codex CLI
description: Installs the standalone OpenAI Codex CLI globally without requiring Node.js or npm, and optionally links Codex state folders into the workspace.

version.description: Codex CLI release version to install. Use 'latest' to resolve the newest release at build time.

installDir.description: Directory where the global codex command symlink is installed.

standaloneHome.description: Directory where standalone Codex release payloads are stored.

linkFolders.description: Optional folder link mappings. Target paths must resolve to absolute container paths. Omit this option when no folder links are needed.

configSyncSource.description: Optional absolute container path to a mounted config.toml file to sync bidirectionally with $CODEX_HOME/config.toml. Omit this option to disable config syncing.
